shortBio.en: Pixies bassist/harmony; Gigantic co-lead; later The Breeders.
shortBio.zh: Pixies 贝斯/和声；Gigantic 共同主唱；后做 The Breeders。

body.en:
Born 1961. Bass + harmony on Doolittle era. Leaves/returns across reunions; Breeders run in parallel.

Second voice that softens Francis scream architecture.
body.zh:
1961 年生。Doolittle 时期贝斯+和声。重聚间离队/回归；Breeders 并行。

软化 Francis 尖叫架构的第二声部。

note.en: Parallel project; not yet in chronicle.
note.zh: 并行项目；尚未入编年史。

whyHub.en: Pixies bass/harmony → The Breeders: same player, different logo and song lead.
whyHub.zh: Pixies 贝斯/和声 → The Breeders：同一乐手、不同 logo 与主笔。
